blocked_sentences: When this creature enters, create a 3/3 colorless Phyrexian Golem artifact creature token.

needs.what: a 3/3 colorless Phyrexian Golem artifact creature token (subtypes Phyrexian and Golem), e.g. id phyrexian_golem_3_3_c_artifact
needs.why_existing_wont_do: token_ids has golem_3_3_c_artifact, a 3/3 colorless Golem artifact creature whose subtypes are only ["Golem"]; it lacks the Phyrexian creature type, so Phyrexian-matters cards would miscount it. The other line, "Golems you control have first strike", is expressible as a grant_keyword static with affects {controller: you, subtypes: [Golem]}
